scenes.text: Have you ever heard of the mysterious "Zone of Death," a bizarre fifty-square-mile strip of wilderness hidden deep inside Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically get away with almost any crime?
Due to a shocking, overlooked loophole in the United States Constitution, this specific uninhabited forest area falls into a terrifying legal dead zone with absolutely no functioning court system.

The Sixth Amendment strictly requires a jury to be selected from the exact state and district where the crime happened, but since nobody lives in this Idaho strip, a legal trial is literally impossible.
Despite this dangerous gap in the American justice system, Congress still has not fixed this massive glitch, so would you ever dare to camp here? Follow for more crazy mysteries.
